Subject: FORMAL RECORD OF THE DENIAL OF ACCESS TO JUSTICE AND ADMINISTRATIVE MALPRACTICE

Ms. Tsakani Soundy (Judiciary); Attention: The Office of the Chief Justice.

​Madam,

​I am writing this under conditions of extreme duress, homelessness, and financial destitution caused directly by my actions as a whistleblower in the public interest. This is no longer a request for assistance; it is a formal indictment of a miscarriage of justice occurring under your watch.

​1. The Fact of the Obstruction
At 09:54 AM today, you confirmed in writing: "I have been informed that your matter was approved and a case number was issued". Despite this confirmation, and knowing my statutory 90-day deadline expires today, 9 April 2026, your office has withheld that case number. This silence is a functional denial of my Section 34 Constitutional Right to Access to Justice.

​2. The Inhumanity of the "Gatekeeper"
I have spent my career as a Specialist Nurse, the very person society relies on in its darkest hours. I was a shift leader in the Resus and Trauma units at Mitchells Plain during the COVID-19 pandemic—showing up every day to protect the vulnerable until the virus claimed me too at the end. My profession dictates that even a rapist is treated with the same dignity and care as any other patient. I have never allowed bias or judgment to overwhelm my duty to provide individual care.

​Yet, as I stand at the "doors of justice," I am met with a cold, administrative refusal to provide a helping hand. I am a carer turned patient, and the system is effectively "throwing me to the dogs".

​3. Systemic Failure and Accountability
Since 5 March 2026, I have faced technical rejections and portal failures that are no fault of my own. I was forced to the High Court in a desperate attempt to be heard, only to have a whistleblower's case struck with punitive Scale C costs—furthering my destitution. My request for the audio for a urgent 42 rescission application also ignored by the Acting Chief Registrar of the High Court Ms Nicola Hanekom in Ms David inbox the silence continues.

​Minister Mmamoloko Kubayi warned on 8 April 2026 that whistleblowers face "weak protections". Your office is currently proving her right. You are reducing a human life, and the safety of 1.9 million GEMS members I sought to protect, to a technicality.

​4. Formal Notice of Liability
I place it on the record for the Chief Justice and the SAHRC: Should my mental health or physical safety decline further as a result of this orchestrated exclusion, the responsibility lies with the Registrar of the Labour Court as the High Court. I have acted with courage to remain alive and fight for myself when no one else would.

​I demand the immediate release of the case number that you have already confirmed exists. The time for "rules" to supersede "humanity" has ended. Justice delayed is justice denied.

​Sr. Wilbur William Matthee
Specialist Registered Nurse, BTech (Psych, Midw, Comm), PG Dip HSM (NQF 8)
Founder: EthicHawks (Forensic Governance and Compliance)
